ui.notable.window_rule: Before and after n use the Insider pages' windows on split-adjusted closes. After publication counts from the last close before the publication could move the price: an SEC filing accepted after the close counts from that close, one accepted before or during a session from the close before; a House or OGE report, known only by its date, from the close before that date. An option row uses its underlying stock; bonds, funds and rows without a code show —. Prices are fetched only for the rows on screen.
